experiments.name: Phase 9 regenerated — Same-selection symbolic oracle ceiling

global_limitations: All benchmark metrics are development-only; no ProofWriter test-split record is included.
The 30-example pilots do not support state-of-the-art, generalisation or statistical-superiority claims.
Oracle formal-structure results are not end-to-end natural-language results.
Phase 5 and Phase 6-R3 are not a paired correction ablation because the original cache was lost.
Unavailable values remain null and are never interpreted as zero.
Phase 9 regenerated evidence under newly frozen protocol; it does not replace historical Phase 3-8 evidence.
Phase 9 is a 30-record development-only regeneration and supports no significance, generalisation or state-of-the-art claim.
Two Phase 9 correction cache outcomes lack complete usage telemetry; exact P1/P2 token totals remain unavailable and partial observed counts are labelled accordingly.
